head_coach.name: Ronald Koeman
head_coach.play_style_summary: Modern interpretation of Total Football emphasizing high pressing, possession-based build-up from the back, numerical superiority in the midfield, and quick transitions with overlapping fullbacks.

key_players.name: Frenkie de Jong
key_players.performance_stats: Technically elite playmaker who serves as the team's primary connector, dropping deep to break opposition press and drive vertical transitions.

key_players.name: Cody Gakpo
key_players.performance_stats: Highly versatile attacker playing on the left wing, known for cutting inside to create goalscoring chances and maintaining excellent form.

key_players.name: Virgil van Dijk
key_players.performance_stats: The team's defensive anchor and captain, dominating aerial duels and breaking opposition defensive lines with precise long-range passing.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruled out following major back surgery
Excluded from the squad due to persistent fitness and injury concerns during the season
